videos.title: Why the Koala Eats Poison Every Day #Shorts

comments.author: @vicleaken
comments.text: Can they also eat other things?
comments.replyText: Great question! Koalas are extremely specialized — eucalyptus makes up almost their entire diet. In rare cases they will nibble other leaves like mistletoe or certain gum trees, but their gut bacteria and liver are tuned specifically for eucalyptus. That is why habitat loss is so dangerous for them — they cannot just switch to another food source.

clipCandidates.momentLabel: A cow would die, a dog would die, a koala eats them for every meal
clipCandidates.why: Core reveal — the comparison to cows and dogs dying makes the koala's superpower concrete. Short, punchy, devastating.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: Why a koala eats what would kill a cow

clipCandidates.momentLabel: Not lazy — surviving on a diet that would kill anything else
clipCandidates.why: Paradox payoff — reframes the 'lazy koala' stereotype as a survival strategy. Emotional close that changes how you see them.
clipCandidates.hookRewrite: Why koalas are not lazy — they are surviving
